ZinPosix.Purpose: Portable POSIX-compatible API surface implemented in Zin over target-native backends. Native Zin programs do not require libc.
ZinPosix.Core: open close read write pread pwrite lseek fstat mmap munmap mprotect socket bind listen accept connect send recv sendmsg recvmsg poll clock_gettime nanosleep pipe dup fcntl ioctl memfd_create ftruncate shm_open getenv process/thread primitives as supported
ZinPosix.WaylandMinimum: Unix-domain stream sockets, fd passing with SCM_RIGHTS-equivalent semantics, shared memory mappings, pollable descriptors, clocks, page-aligned mmap, close-on-exec semantics.

Backends.Brix: Implemented over std.os.brix native handles/services; POSIX facade may translate brix native primitives.

ZinPosix.NotNativeMandate: brixOS native kernel ABI does not need to be POSIX internally.
